items.title: Mass limit of the Maskit gluing of constant-scalar-curvature ALH manifolds at general conformal boundaries
items.author: Chruściel, Piotr T., Delay, Erwann
items.work: On Asymptotically Locally Hyperbolic Metrics with Negative Mass
items.difficulty_reason: H3：1823-1835、1892-2473针对任意非球面conformal boundary的Maskit neck degeneration，构造双端爆破的hyperbolic annulus barrier防面积集中，利用带Dirac源的比较函数把Yamabe方程转为可施Harnack的uniformly bounded-potential方程，得到穿孔面C-infinity局部收敛，再由Deligne-Mumford compactness识别cusp hyperbolic limit并以Gauss-Bonnet保证第二侧面积非零，最终接作者引用的CDW质量公式。难点是退化颈部的非坍缩/无面积损失及limiting conformal factor，不因582行长度判H3。

primary.label: author Theorem environment with its own label NoST29VII21.1 (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1823-1835

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the Theorem: for N three-dimensional ALH summands with metrics of the prescribed form and cusp metrics e^{omega_a} h_{kappa_a} punctured at the gluing points, the mass of the Maskit-glued metric converges, as the gluing radius epsilon tends to zero and the gluing parameter i tends to infinity, to the finite limit -sum_a of the Ricci-contraction integrals with conformal factor e^{-omega_a/2} r; the proof adapts the CDW construction to general conformal boundaries, proving existence of the limiting conformal factors omega_a on both summands (the equivalent of Lemma 5.9 of CDW) with the remaining steps as in CDW (source lines 1892-2473)
